pages.title: Fair Winds
pages.text: Sail at least 64 blocks across water with raised sails.

pages.title: Fair Winds
pages.text: A spare sail, leads and provisions support the next transport voyage.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Launch into open water, take the controller seat and raise sails with the configured key. Cargo affects handling. Compatible creatures can board; sneak-use from outside opens storage. Dye changes sails and Name Tags change the name.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Streams follow the terrain through lakes at different elevations toward larger rivers and the sea. Follow the downstream basin to plan a route; a large ship may not fit a shallow stream.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: When enabled by the server, directional river currents carry boats and loose items downstream. Check the direction in a safe stretch before a cargo trip. Directional flow and water momentum can be disabled separately, so a generated river does not guarantee passive travel.
